convert_data2vec_checkpoint: convert a Data2Vec Vision PyTorch checkpoint to Hugging Face transformers format using a BEiT pretrained model
create_rename_keys: create weight key renaming mappings from BEiT backbone to Hugging Face Data2VecVision encoder layers
read_in_q_k_v: split BEiT combined qkv projection weights into separate query, key, and value weight tensors for HF
run_data2vec_conversion_cli: run the Data2Vec Vision checkpoint conversion CLI with --beit_checkpoint and --hf_checkpoint_name arguments
verify_conversion_output: verify the converted HF model produces outputs matching the original PyTorch model within tolerance
